title: Safe Catalog Manual Overrides with Actor Provenance
context: Collector syncs periodically overwrite Game fields. If an administrator manually corrects a title or product class directly on Game, subsequent syncs overwrite it unless separated.
decision: Create GameManualOverride table holding explicit typed overrides (title, publisher, developer, franchise, releaseDate, productClass, imageUrl, isActive) with actor and reason provenance, preserving raw Game source data.
alternatives: Directly update Game table on manual edit (overwritten on next collector sync)
Store arbitrary unvalidated JSON in Game model
consequences: Raw Xbox collector data is always preserved intact
Audit trail tracks who overrode what and why
Reset override restores raw collector data cleanly
risks: Application queries must always resolve effective values instead of raw Game fields directly where applicable.
evidence: src/lib/pricing/price-sync.ts and mapper.ts overwrite game records on each pass
